title: German-Style Stir-Fry with Freekeh
description: A fusion of Chinese stir-frying techniques and traditional German ingredients, this dish combines the nutty flavor of freekeh with the savory taste of German sausage.
instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and bell pepper and fry until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the sliced mushrooms and continue to fry for another 2-3 minutes.
Add the sausage and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the freekeh and cook, stirring frequently, for 2-3 minutes.
Add the tomato paste, chicken broth, and herbs. Stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes.
Stir in the diced tomato and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs.
